steps.content: The light of the Black Ring gradually concentrates and eventually turns into a fire that burns the body of the Corpseborne and dissolves the existence of the former Ring Master. The once fast-expanding shell splits, shatters, and vanishes.
At some point, the feeling of restriction that has been plaguing your soul suddenly disappears.

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: I never would've thought that you'd hand over the decision-making to someone else... I've known you to be full of surprises, but I never expected this kind of surprise.

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: Forget about the success rate. Without the benefit of collective observation, the level of uncertainty surrounding this plan is almost infinite.

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: Was it a gamble? You surrendered yourself to fate by choice... Sigh, I wouldn't have had the courage to make that choice.

options: There was only so much I could do, after all.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I witnessed the great efforts of many people. Although some of them were not strong, they did their best.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Think about it, would a coward stay in the Black Ring for that long? By then all the frightened ones had already left. Those who stayed, who were still helping out... must have been most courageous.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I couldn't foresee the fate of the West District, but I trusted them to give me the answer.

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: ...I see. You can trust others because you have seen a bigger world and more genuine "people," because you are... not alone.

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: I'm envious of you. If I were more like you, I might have come up with a better solution, and everyone would have suffered less. I'm sorry.

options: ...I'm not that trusting, to be honest.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: At first, I didn't want to trust a "Paradeisian" like you. Your appearance threw the entire Black Ring into turmoil; I knew you must have done something unusual.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But all this way, I have received protection from many people I have never met before. And perhaps you're among these people.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You seemed convinced that they would keep me safe, until this day...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Plus...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: When I was in mortal danger, someone risked her life to take hold of me and bring you to me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: She didn't say a word, and I'm afraid she never will speak the truth about herself. But the sincerity she showed was impossible to miss. It's true that you've been treated as a tool by some people, but there are others who trust you deeply.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So I think there's no need for you to be envious of me.

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: ...I see... Is that how it is...

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: I thought they had all left, considering they each had their own path to follow...
A myriad of emotions flows freely in her eyes. You wish to savor the moment, but the Black Ring begins to collapse, and the realm of consciousness fades away.

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: Looks like time is running out.

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: Please take care of them for me. They are nothing like me, but they're a lot like you; sooner or later, they will come and rally around you.

options: What about you? You are not coming?

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: Me? I'm fine. Don't worry about me. And I hope you can forget this encounter of ours. You'll be safer if you do.

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: You always choose the path of most resistance. Neither running away nor causing havoc, you confront your challenges and look for new possibilities... Things are only going to get more overwhelming for you. Be careful.

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: Our destinies are linked. They've changed each other. There's nothing to regret.

options: ...Looks like the time hasn't come yet.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We'll meet again. And our friends will join us the next time we meet.
She is on the verge of saying something but thinks better of it. She only gives a smile.

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: I'm glad that you've gained your freedom. So... I wish you happiness.

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: By the way, if you guessed wrong and the people of the West District chose another path... What would you do?

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: Would you still think any of this was worthwhile?

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: Hmm... There's that interesting expression on your face again. It's a look that I'm familiar with.

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: Luckily, fate led them to this path.

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: Off you go. Someone's here to pick you up.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Got you! What were you just staring at?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Syndicate, I guess.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Oh, it truly is a splendid sight.
The red light of the Black Ring fades. Dust hangs above the entire Syndicate like smoke. Through the thin layer of rust-colored mist, you see many people, running, crying, laughing.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief is still in the Tower. Go find him!
steps.female_content: Chief is still in the Tower. Go find her!

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: We will go question the civilians, and that executive officer... Donald.
The Paradeisian knight lies on the ground. Schorl is nowhere in sight. Staring at the deranged Black Ring, she bursts into hearty laughter.
Hahaha... hahaha...
This is good... I'm... making progress too...

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Ah! We've found an injured person here. Inform Adjutant Nightingale! Someone needs help!

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Are you all right? let me...
No, thank you.
The warrior picks herself up from the floor.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Your voice... You are...
Take care.
She refastens her helmet. A new Schorl floats over, and she silently walks ahead.
(Scene change)
Thistle walks behind Mentor, sobbing uncontrollably and clutching a corner of Mentor's clothes as if her life depends on it.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: All right, stop crying now. Did you really think anybody could hurt me? Look at me, not a scratch—good as new. It was not a big deal. I told you I'd be back. Have I ever lied to you?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Gee, with you being such a crybaby, how am I supposed to let go? <size=30>I just can't bring myself to...</size>

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: This is really great. I'd imagined many possible outcomes, and I'd been very positive and creative in my imagining.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: But I never thought that Syndicate would end up with an outcome this good.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Thank you, Chief.
Donald's face takes on a surprised expression.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Everyone here is a hero.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Pfft, hahaha... Putting you back into Paradeisos's hands wouldn't sit right with me. Might as well...
As he speaks, he glances down and chuckles.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Too bad, the hook I brought today can't handle the weight of the two of us; otherwise, I'd whisk you away right now.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Maybe next time.
He unhooks you. Now the only thing that keeps you from falling is his hand holding yours.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Reluctant to part company with me? But I promised someone that I'd send you back.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: When you find them to be a handful next time, just reach out to me. I'll come and return the favor. Until we meet again.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Now, she's coming to get you.
He lets go of your hand. The remaining Black Ring force field distorts spacetime, slowing your fall significantly.
You watch the High Tower fading away. Before it disappears into the clouds, you see the vague shape of what appears to be a long flight of steps.
On the steps are figures climbing slowly...

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: I am weak, always have been.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: No sturdy legs to stand on, no formidable power to wield, nor a constantly soaring spirit to fight with.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: But I have friends, ideals, and a hometown that once embraced me.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: I want to become an architect, and restore Syndicate to its former glory.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: To give everyone shelter and hope.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: That is its true glory.
In a trance, you see the architect turn around, see countless people step onto the stairs one after another.
You see Lavina, Donald, the Sinners, and many other people, familiar and unfamiliar, and you see...
Yourself.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief!

A girl's call brings you back to reality. The illusion vanishes. Nightmare is flying toward you, its wings spread wide. Hecate, seated on Nightmare's back, extends her hand to you, her eyes eager, intense, filled with so many emotions.
It's early morning. A girl stealthily slips out onto a dim street of Syndicate.
A voice from behind startles her.
Where are you going?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Y-you gave me a scare, Hecate...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I was going to the bathroom. Why were you following me?
She averts her eyes, looking guilty.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: The bathroom is over there, to the east.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Really? Ah, I remembered there are some convenience stores this way that I used to frequent. So, I thought I'd go and...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: All closed down during the riot.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Uh, I forgot that, I...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Hella, are you leaving?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: No!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I just need some... some space... I've got a lot in my head. I just need to straighten it out...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: You were leaving without telling us? You haven't met Chief since we came back, have you?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: <size=30>...I don't want to meet Chief.</size>

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: If I did, then I wouldn't be able leave. So... no, I guess....
steps.female_content: If I did, then I wouldn' t be able leave. So... no, I guess....

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Don't snitch on me... I'm not running away! I'll write to you guys, um, even if there are lots of spelling errors.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: The MBCC is okay. There's training and stuff... But what I can see and do in the MBCC is still too limited. And if I stay, I'll always be under someone else's protection...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What I'm trying to say is, I want to be my own person and make something of myself. And then I'll come back to see you.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Okay.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...I want to be stronger, I want to be a protector, someone who can really protect others...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hecate, you know what I'm getting at, right?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Yes, I do.
(CG1)
Hecate takes a step forward, and before Hella can skedaddle like a little rat, hugs her.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What the... whaaat-t... Ahh...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What are you doing?! Who does that! Stop it. Let go, let go of me... Someone's got to be watching. This is embarrassing!
(CG2)

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Don't worry. No one is watching.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I understand. I understand why you want to become stronger so that you can protect what is close to your heart.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: This is what you taught me. When I was lost, it was you who reached out to me, let me know I was not alone; you are the reason I'm back at Chief's side.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: So, it's only fair that I should give you my support when you need it. Go for it, Hella.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What about your mission?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: You mean the task of supervising you? It's okay, I don't want to fulfill it anymore. Chief will help me sort it out; you're more important than those tasks.
(CG3)

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Because Hella is my friend, the first friend I chose for myself.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Don't forget to visit us often. I'll miss you.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Sob...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Waaaaaaaaaaaah! This is why I didn't want to see you before I leave. This is making it so much harder to leave. Idiot, idiot... Hecate, you big idiot!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ?! Why are you...
You bear-hug Hella and Hecate.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Do you know there's something called "release on bail pending trial"?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Out there, you better not indulge in your old habit. It's one thing to pick my pocket, but quite another to steal from others. So don't steal, or you'll be arrested and sent back here.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: All right, let me take a good look at your face before you go. I bet you'll look completely different the next time I see you.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Waaaah! Don't look at me! Go back now, you two big dummies!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I'll be back to visit you. But you need to visit me as well. Do you hear me?
(Scene change)

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: A lot has happened in the bureau during your long absence. Some outsiders have interfered in our affairs, and our Sinners have suffered greatly. The city has changed, so has the overall atmosphere; the MBCC has had to change as well.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: But everyone knows how the MBCC is supposed to be. They remember the looks of the things they hold dear, hoping to restore them to the way they used to be upon your return.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: We've been waiting for this day for so long.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Welcome back, Chief. You've been sorely missed.

About the provider of the White Cube and the numerous pieces of underground information, Donald is tight-lipped.

All he says on the subject is that Chief will soon meet those people Chief once met before.

As the MBCC investigates those involved in the incident, a prime suspect comes to the surface, but the lead soon comes to a dead end.

"Rust," a 9th Agency agent assigned to Syndicate, is reported dead in the incident.

Langley doesn't say much by way of explanation, but uncharacteristically, she doesn't show much sorrow for the death of her subordinate either.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: I'm sorry. I've tried my best to keep them from meeting. Miss Bai stayed in the Black Ring. I didn't expect to see her fall into the hands of the 9th Agency...

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: My "boss" is quite intimidating.
Hehe, no matter how intimidating that place is, Miss Bai will never return to you. She has a place in mind.
Besides, the MBCC is a good place to be, with that little Chief at the helm.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Calling you "little Chief" doesn't seem appropriate now. You've done a lot of great things. Quite impressive.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: What, you are getting nostalgic and want to pay a visit?

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Maybe another time. Syndicate doesn't need a violent leader anymore. They can forge their own path now.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Anyone who still tries to stand in their way or takes advantage of them... I'll take care of it.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: You can change your code name now. BR-002 is defeated, your life as "Rust" has come to an end. It's time to move on to the next fight.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: You've got a point.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Now that the Black Ring in the West District has been destroyed, we "monsters" who have been residing inside the Ring can't stay here anymore. It's time to move.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: See you wherever the next Black Ring crops up, ${PlayerName}.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: I hope to see the real you the next time around.

Out of the ruins of the BR-002, the largest Black Ring, rises the largest <color=#fb9259>stand-alone Hypercube mine</color> to date.

Nirvana mounts a bid for its ownership. However, since Paradeisos has closed the access to a certain technology based on the BR-002's Mania field, super-loop communication can no longer be maintained inside the ruins.
One thing is certain; in the coming years, Nirvana won't be able to carry out machine-based unmanned mining in the new mine.

Manual mining has to be applied to the huge wealth of BR-002 Hypercube. This seemingly forgotten technique is in the hands of Julien, the former leader of Rustfire.

This gives the new Inner Bay organization bargaining power against Nirvana.
With the support of logistics, trade, and mysterious funding, a new round of meetings will proceed as scheduled.

Surprisingly, Paradeisos is not fully on board with Nirvana's proposals this time.
They seem more interested in understanding the principles of how the BR-002 was destroyed.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Long time no see. I heard you've made great contributions in the battle. It wouldn't seem right to call you a "rookie" anymore.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Ready to meet those old geezers from Paradeisos? You've grown so much; surely you won't be nervous, right Chief?

steps.speaker: Paradeisos 03
steps.content: The Rules in SHP-13 are confirmed to be in effect once again. Tighten security; the request for contact is approved.

steps.speaker: Paradeisos 03
steps.content: Thank you for your cooperation, ${PlayerName}. I thought you would die in the BR-002. It surprised me when you came on board with the Paradeisos's proposal and accepted the restrictions of the Rules.

steps.speaker: Paradeisos 03
steps.content: Am I correct in assuming you represent a new possibility for humanity in the future?

steps.speaker: Paradeisos 02
steps.content: The unorthodox measures taken by the FAC and 9th Agency, they must have counted on you for the success of these measures, to a degree at least. You did exceed our expectations. We should have come and met you sooner... before X left.

steps.speaker: Paradeisos 02
steps.content: Fortunately, we still have plenty of time.

steps.speaker: Paradeisos 02
steps.content: Go ahead, someone has been waiting for you.

steps.speaker: Paradeisos 01
steps.content: While I was talking with you inside the Ring, I had a vague feeling that we might meet again.

steps.speaker: Paradeisos 01
steps.content: Hello, Chief ${PlayerName} of Minos. Reason told me to reject your radical plan, but... it did remind me of some interesting past events.

steps.speaker: Paradeisos 01
steps.content: Let's judge it by its outcome then.

steps.speaker: Paradeisos 01
steps.content: Thank you for buying us precious time. There's so much more we can talk about next.
The Corpus that hasn't been absorbed yet... the shattered, severely weakened BR-002...
At a certain point, you sensed the feeble existence of a breathing thing on the other end of the shackles, until...

steps.speaker: Corpus 002
steps.content: Hahaha... I survived, just like back then, I survived...
Back in the tower, just before it was reduced to nothingness, it latched onto a little something called "Rustfire." As luck would have it, it now has a new anchor point.

steps.speaker: Corpus 002
steps.content: You can't kill me... I refuse to accept that fate... I will reclaim what's rightfully mine, I have patience, and will regain my power... I will come back... no matter how many times it takes, I will come back for you...

steps.speaker: Corpus 002
steps.content: ...Wait and see. One of these days, I...
Its soliloquy comes to a sudden stop. It's just realized that it's back in DisSea, back to where everything started, to the most dangerous place.
Why is it back? It has been avoiding the place. Could it be...
This is a special gift from my lovely "little brother."
steps.female_content: This is a special gift from my lovely "little sister."

steps.content: You must have sensed me too, right? My dear...
